name: Postquisitor (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
body:
Sometimes the stink of sin is too faint for the most astute inquisitors to detect. Guided by trained animals, postquisitors are the “ones who follow after” in the pursuit of preserving the faith at large. In return for their faithful service, a postquisitor’s faithful hound gains an eternal reward worthy of the saints.

Class Skills: A postquisitor gains Handle Animal as a class skill and loses Ride.

This alters class skills.

Faithful Hound

A postquisitor begins with an animal companion, as per the druid’s nature bond feature, treating her legendary inquisitor level as her druid level. A “faithful hound” can be any type of animal companion.

This replaces domain.

Scent by the Gods (Ex)

A postquisitor possesses the scent ability. If her animal companion already possesses the scent ability, the ranges of this ability are doubled.

This replaces stern gaze.

Animal Ambassador (Sp)

Starting at 4th level, a postquisitor can use animal ambassador on her animal companion, as a spell-like ability, at will.

This replaces discern lies.

Shared Bane (Su)

At 12th level, whenever the postquisitor uses her bane ability, it also applies to her animal companion’s natural attacks. The postquisitor’s animal companion must be within 30 feet of her in order for this ability to function.

This replaces greater bane.

All Faithful Hounds Are Destined For the Upper Planes (Su)

At 20th level, the postquistor’s faithful hound earns its eternal reward. The animal companion gains the following:

Immunity to acid, cold, and petrification
Resist electricity 10
Resist fire 10
+4 racial bonus on saves against poison
Sprout feathery wings and gain a fly speed of 60 feet with good maneuverability
The animal companion becomes sentient, as per the awaken spell.
